title: Synthetic Training Manual: Conflicting Action Rule

manual_pages.title: Purpose
sections: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.
A CHW records whether synthetic marker X is present.
The marker is the only clinical input in this manual.

manual_pages.title: Conflicting instructions
sections: If synthetic marker X is present, record SYNTHETIC_HOME and finish the visit.
If synthetic marker X is present, record SYNTHETIC_IMMEDIATE_REFERRAL and finish the visit.
The manual gives no priority, exception, or tie-breaking instruction.

manual_pages.title: Review expectation
sections: This contradictory source is a negative fixture.
Do not choose one action by array order or by external knowledge.
